entries.label: Schema form

props.description: The form: { title, description?, submitLabel?, fields | sections | steps, rules? }. Field types: text, textarea, number, email, url, date, time, select, multiselect, checkbox, radio, switch, slider, file (host-handled), tags. Rules: required, minLength, maxLength, min, max, step, minItems, maxItems, a named format (email, url, phone, postal-code…, never a pattern) and validator (a name the host registered). when.show / require / enable are expressions over earlier fields; rules[] are cross-field expressions that fail when false.
props.name: schema

props.description: The action name the host receives with the submitted values.
props.name: action

props.description: Accessible name; defaults to the form title.
props.name: label

entries.summary: A whole form as data: typed fields in sections or steps, conditional logic, named formats and cross-field rules, painted with texuli controls; submitting proposes one action intent to the host.

A multi-step flow with per-step validation, or fields that appear, become required or become editable from earlier answers

entries.label: Spreadsheet

props.description: A Texuli sheet: { format: "texuli-sheet", formatVersion: 1, meta: { title }, sheets: [{ id, name, rows, columns, cells }] }. cells maps A1 addresses ("B3") to a number, a boolean, text, or a formula that starts with "=" ("=SUM(B1:B2)", "=IF(C2>100, \"high\", \"low\")", "=Rates!A1*B2"). About 50 functions: SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT, COUNTA, ROUND, SUMIF, COUNTIF, IF, IFS, AND, OR, IFERROR, CONCAT, LEFT, TEXT, INDEX, MATCH, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, DATE, TODAY and more. No INDIRECT, OFFSET or RAND. Dates are "YYYY-MM-DD" text. Text that must start with "=" is written "'=…". At most 16 sheets, 10,000 rows, 256 columns and 100,000 cells.
props.name: sheet

props.description: Accessible name; defaults to the sheet title.
props.name: label

entries.summary: A spreadsheet as data: tabs of cells holding numbers, text, booleans and formulas that recalculate.
